text.zh-CN:
下尿路感染主要累及膀胱或尿道，常出现尿痛、尿频和尿急。

- 膀胱储存尿液，尿道把尿液排到体外。
- 有时伴下腹不适或血尿；尿液仅有异味不一定代表感染。
- 发热和腰背痛可能提示感染位置更高，需要另行评估。
text.en:
Lower urinary infection usually affects the bladder or urethra.

- The bladder stores urine; the urethra carries it out.
- Burning, frequent or urgent urination may occur; smell alone does not prove infection.
- Fever or back pain may indicate infection involving the kidneys.

text.zh-CN:
常见机制是细菌进入尿路。

- 来自肠道的细菌可经尿道进入膀胱，尿道较短的人更容易感染。
- 排尿不畅、结石或导尿管可增加风险。
- 妊娠、绝经后变化、免疫功能减弱及糖尿病也会影响风险。
text.en:
Bacteria commonly enter through the urethra.

- Bowel bacteria can reach the bladder; a shorter urethra increases susceptibility.
- Poor bladder emptying, stones or catheters raise risk.
- Pregnancy, menopause, reduced immunity and diabetes also matter.

text.zh-CN:
不要把全身恶化当成普通尿痛。

- 新发意识混乱、嗜睡或说话困难，应立即寻求急救。
- 明显发热、寒战或肋骨下方背痛，需要尽快排查肾脏感染。
- 病情快速变重时不要只增加饮水等待。
text.en:
Do not treat systemic deterioration as simple cystitis.

- New confusion, drowsiness or trouble speaking needs emergency help.
- Fever, shaking or pain below the ribs needs prompt assessment for kidney infection.
- Rapid worsening requires care rather than simply drinking more water.

text.zh-CN:
就医取决于人群和变化。

- 孕妇、儿童、男性、老年人或免疫功能低下者出现症状，应尽快咨询。
- 治疗后约两天仍无改善或更重，应复诊。
- 反复感染、血尿或持续不适需要查原因，不能反复照搬旧处方。
text.en:
Care depends on personal circumstances and progression.

- Pregnant people, children, men, older adults and immunocompromised people need prompt advice.
- Return if symptoms worsen or fail to improve after about two days of treatment.
- Recurrence, blood in urine or persistent symptoms needs reassessment.

text.zh-CN:
医生会把症状与尿液结果一起判断。

- 典型症状有时即可支持判断，并非每次都需要尿检。
- 尿液检查可帮助寻找感染证据，反复或复杂情况可能需要进一步检查。
- 单凭尿色、气味或一次结果，不能解释所有持续尿路不适。
text.en:
Diagnosis combines symptoms with test findings.

- Typical symptoms may sometimes be sufficient without a urine test.
- Urine testing and further assessment may be needed in recurrent or complicated cases.
- Colour, smell or one result cannot explain every persistent urinary symptom.

text.zh-CN:
尿痛也可能有其他原因。

- 肾脏感染会改变紧急程度，尤其有发热、寒战和背痛时。
- 结石或排尿梗阻可能导致疼痛、血尿并增加感染风险。
- 检查不支持感染或治疗无效时，要重新考虑其他尿路或生殖道问题。
text.en:
Painful urination has other possible causes.

- Kidney infection changes urgency, especially with fever, shaking and back pain.
- Stones or obstruction may cause pain or bleeding and promote infection.
- Persistent symptoms need review for other urinary or genital conditions.

text.zh-CN:
治疗旨在减轻不适并控制感染。

- 有些轻症可在专业评估后短期观察，不适合所有人自行等待。
- 需要时使用短疗程抗生素，具体选择取决于人群和情况。
- 反复感染可能需要专科评估与预防方案，而非无限重复同一种药。
text.en:
Treatment relieves symptoms and controls infection.

- Observation may be appropriate after assessment in selected mild cases.
- Antibiotics are used when indicated, with the choice tailored to circumstances.
- Recurrent infection may need specialist assessment and a prevention plan.

text.zh-CN:
抗生素和止痛药作用不同。

- 抗生素针对细菌，应按本次处方完成，不借用剩药。
- 止痛药可减轻痛和发热，但不能证明感染已经清除。
- 无效或出现不良反应时联系医生，勿自行延长或更换疗程。
- 若使用抗生素，可能出现恶心或腹泻；呼吸困难、咽喉紧或口舌肿胀可能是严重过敏，应立即求助。
text.en:
Antibiotics and pain relief have different roles.

- Take antibiotics as prescribed for this episode rather than using leftovers.
- Pain relief does not establish that infection has cleared.
- Contact the clinician about failure or adverse effects rather than changing the course yourself.
- When antibiotics are used, nausea or diarrhoea may occur; breathing difficulty, throat tightness or mouth or tongue swelling may signal a serious allergy and need immediate help.

text.zh-CN:
饮水有助舒适，不能代替必要治疗。

- 适当补液，避免因怕尿痛而持续少喝水。
- 咖啡和酒精等饮品若加重刺激，可暂时减少。
- 蔓越莓等产品不能用来治疗已经发生的尿路感染。
text.en:
Fluids can support comfort but do not replace treatment.

- Avoid restricting fluids simply because urination hurts.
- Reduce coffee or alcohol if they aggravate symptoms.
- Cranberry products do not treat an established infection.

text.zh-CN:
日常护理围绕排尿和观察。

- 有尿意及时排尿，并给自己足够时间排空膀胱。
- 记录发热、血尿、腰痛及开始用药的时间，方便复诊。
- 外阴保持清洁干燥，避免有香味清洁剂造成刺激。
text.en:
Self-care centres on emptying the bladder and observing changes.

- Urinate when needed and allow time to empty the bladder.
- Record fever, bleeding, back pain and treatment start time.
- Keep the genital area clean and dry and avoid perfumed irritants.

text.zh-CN:
部分人群不能按普通轻症处理。

- 孕期感染需要及时评估，药物选择也不同。
- 幼儿可能表现为发热、烦躁和进食减少，而非会描述尿痛。
- 老年人或导尿者出现意识变化需要评估，不能仅凭这一表现自行确诊尿路感染。
text.en:
Some groups need a different approach.

- Pregnancy requires timely assessment and suitable medicine choices.
- Young children may have fever, irritability or poor feeding rather than describe burning.
- Confusion in older or catheterised people needs assessment, not an automatic UTI diagnosis.

text.zh-CN:
治疗后的变化比单次症状更有帮助。

- 症状未按预期改善时，应核对诊断和治疗。
- 半年内两次或一年三次感染属于需要评估的反复情况。
- 持续不适即使尿检不典型，也应寻求重新评估而非自行长期用药。
text.en:
Progress after treatment matters.

- Lack of improvement prompts review of both diagnosis and treatment.
- Two episodes in six months or three in a year warrants recurrence assessment.
- Persistent symptoms need reassessment even if urine tests are not typical of infection, rather than unsupervised long-term medication.

text.zh-CN:
感染并不总停留在膀胱。

- 向上累及肾脏后，可出现发热、腰背痛和明显不适。
- 严重感染可引起全身危重反应，需要急救。
- 反复症状也会影响睡眠和生活，需要寻找可处理的原因。
text.en:
Infection may extend beyond the bladder.

- Kidney involvement may cause fever, back pain and systemic illness.
- Severe infection can cause a life-threatening systemic response.
- Repeated symptoms may disrupt sleep and daily life and need a cause-focused review.

text.zh-CN:
预防应针对个人风险。

- 不要长期憋尿，保持适当饮水和排尿习惯。
- 如厕后从前向后清洁，避免把肠道细菌带向尿道。
- 反复感染时讨论排尿不畅、避孕用品或绝经后变化，预防用药需专业决定。
text.en:
Prevention should address individual risk.

- Avoid prolonged urine holding and maintain suitable hydration.
- Wipe from front to back after using the toilet.
- Recurrent episodes warrant discussion of emptying problems, contraception or menopause-related changes.
